items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Moose, put your name down. We want to get your name today. What is it? Manuel Joseph Zango. Moose. Moose, okay. [INTERVIEWEE] Ha, ha, ha, Moose. That's funny about the thing. The average musician that got something kind of funny name.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was telling him how rough he was. Wasn't he rough with all of them? Pop, like that. That's what he used to play with.
Moose, put your name down. We want to get your name today. What is it? Manuel Joseph Zango. Moose. Moose, okay.
Ha, ha, ha, Moose. That's funny about the thing. The average musician that got something kind of funny name.
